relationships.subject: satellite glial cells
relationships.evidence_quote: DRG-SGCs have stem cell characteristics and can efficiently differentiate into functional nociceptive sensory neurons

relationships.subject: Wnt signaling
relationships.evidence_quote: Wnt signaling promotes the differentiation of DRG-SGCs into nociceptive sensory neurons by regulating the expression of specific transcription factor Runx1

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: these cells exhibited rapid calcium transients in response to capsaicin through binding to the Trpv1 vanilloid receptor

key_findings: DRG satellite glial cells differentiate into functional nociceptive neurons with small molecule cocktail (VPA, CHIR99021, RO4929097, SU5402).
Wnt regulates Runx1; Notch and FGF are involved in SCN9A expression.
